name: hydra-tv-ui-monorepo
description: Monorepo for the @hydra-tv component libraries (design tokens, generic components, broadcast-specific components) and their demo playground.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @hydra-tv/ui && npm run build -w @hydra-tv/broadcast
scripts.publish:packages: npm run build && npm publish -w @hydra-tv/tokens && npm publish -w @hydra-tv/ui && npm publish -w @hydra-tv/broadcast
